2. docs/agents/protocols/ISSUE_QUEUE.md: apply the two cross-reference sentence insertions the design specifies (quoted in step-02's result.summary under 'ISSUE_QUEUE.md CROSS-REFERENCE DECISION') -- one appended to the end of the existing `instrumented` bullet, one appended to the end of the existing `no_defect` bullet's evidence-bar paragraph, in the 'Issue status vocabulary' section.

3. WIDENED SCOPE (added by ORCH beyond the design's own owned_modules, because leaving it undone means every future WF-03 run repeats ISS-0458's exact mistake): docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 5 (around line 206-213) currently instructs release_lock(status:"done") unconditionally on this step's PASS, with no branch for instrumented/no_defect outcomes -- this is the design's own 'WF-03_issue_resolving.md STEP 5 FINDING' (quoted in step-02's result.summary). Rewrite that instruction to branch on the local docs/issues/ISS-NNNN.yaml status Step 5 section 1 just wrote: `resolved` -> release_lock(status: "done"); `instrumented` or `no_defect` -> release_lock(status: "blocked"). Mirror the branching structure Step 5's own section 2 (the GitHub close-comment text) already uses for the same three-way split, a few lines above -- match that existing style rather than inventing a new one.

4. Verify the result reads coherently as one piece: read all three edited files back in full after editing, confirm no formatting break, no dangling cross-reference, no duplicate content.

5. Do NOT touch letflow-queue's repo in this step. Do NOT re-release queue task 458 in this step -- that is a separate ORCH action after this step merges (per the design's AC3 recommendation), not part of this handoff.

SECURITY-REVIEWER is SKIPPED for this step, stated explicitly here rather than left implicit: this change touches only docs/agents/protocols/*.md and docs/agents/workflows/*.md prose -- no lib/, no priv/repo/migrations/, no tenant-data path, no supervision-tree file.
